chat.text: I'm sorry you're thinking of leaving, Sam. Could you tell me why you'd like to cancel your Pro Family plan?
It's just too expensive for me now. I live alone, so I'm barely using the family part.
I understand. Your plan includes ad-free listening, offline downloads, HiFi audio and family sharing. Which of these can't you do without?
Honestly, the hi-fi audio and offline downloads. I listen on my commute and need the downloads to work without signal, and I'm not going back to compressed sound.

You could switch to Hi-Fi Solo for $24 a month instead of $39. You'd keep HiFi audio, offline downloads and ad-free listening, and only lose family sharing, which you said you barely use. The change would take effect today. Would you like to switch?
Yes, that works for me. Switch me to Hi-Fi Solo at $24 a month, and please confirm once it's done.

You're all set, Sam. Your account now shows the Hi-Fi Solo plan at $24 a month, with HiFi audio, offline downloads and ad-free listening, and your confirmation number is CH-1. Family sharing has been removed, and your subscription is still active.
Awesome, this is great! Thanks a lot!

beats.text: The customer already has their confirmation, and it rested on the plan change the customer system made and the model then read back. The case note is after-call work: a summary for the support team's CRM, written from the whole transcript once the chat is over. Structured outputs make the reply match a JSON schema.

beats.label: case note JSON
beats.title: The model writes the case note
beats.text: Valid JSON, every field present. But the model wrote these values from its reading of the transcript, so any of them could still be wrong. A schema checks the shape of an answer, not whether it is true.

raw.summary: Customer requested cancellation due to cost, was offered and accepted a switch from Pro Family ($39/month) to Hi-Fi Solo ($24/month) keeping HiFi audio, offline downloads and ad-free while dropping family sharing, confirmed by CH-1 and verified active on the account.

beats.label: fact-check case note
beats.title: Fact-check the case note before saving it
beats.text: The harness checks the three fields it can prove against facts it already holds: customer_id against the login session, and outcome and offer_presented against the customer system's own log of what happened. Free text such as summary cannot be checked this way. All three match, so the note is saved.

name: Handle Cancel Request and Offer Different Subscription
